# fyre_user_api_key (Data Source)

Fetches the expiration date for the authenticated user's API key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `details` (String) Human-readable message about the API key
- `expiration` (String) API key expiration timestamp in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
- `id` (String) Data source identifier (always set to 'user_api_key')
- `status` (String) Response status from the API
